column1: # Checksums of the nine inputs the reported run (2026-10-16/17) consumed.
# attested_by says how strongly each line is tied to that run:
#   run_manifest  this exact sha256 is recorded in the run's own
#                 verification_manifest.json, so the file is provably the
#                 one that produced the reported results.
#   run_shape     the run's log records this matrix's shape (see
#                 run_logged_shape, samples x SGBs) and the local file has
#                 exactly that shape and this size. Strong, but a shape is
#                 not a checksum: the run hashes only the reported
#                 reference's matrices, so no sha256 exists on that side.
#   local_only    hashed here from the same tree, with nothing on the run
#                 side to compare against.
# Columns of a mean-and-std matrix come in pairs, so a logged SGB count is
# half the CSV's column count.
# Regenerating the run would NOT strengthen this: it would consume these
# same files, and verify_reproducibility.py records only the reported
# reference's external inputs.
